scope: Full DES algorithm article only; no completion claim for TDEA/3DES, Feistel networks, modes of operation, AES, DES events/standards or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 algorithm--des 这一算法的分组结构、密钥调度、公开标准历史、穷举与密码分析边界；不把 3DES/TDEA、Feistel 网络、工作模式、AES 或相关事件/标准并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the algorithm recorded as algorithm--des: block structure, key schedule, public-standard history, exhaustion and cryptanalysis limits. It does not absorb TDEA/3DES, Feistel networks, modes of operation, AES, or related events and standards.
